articles.title: No. 2 Pioneer scores 20 unanswered points to beat Cass
articles.summary: Walton Pioneer achieved a remarkable turnaround, recovering from an initial 15-0 deficit to secure a 20-15 victory over Lewis Cass on Friday night at Owens Memorial Field. The Class 1A No. 2 Panthers displayed strong resilience, completing a stunning comeback against their rivals in a hard-fought contest, showcasing admirable sportsmanship and determination.

articles.title: This company wants to stop underwater drones and even submarines with a whole new form of sonar technology
articles.summary: Ultra Maritime is testing a new system to detect underwater drones at the US Navy's Lanternfish 2026 exercise. It pairs the Sea Spear passive sonar array with the AN/SSQ-125B active sonobuoy. This integration aims to bolster naval capabilities against modern underwater threats, demonstrating advancements in defence technology for maritime security.
